about.title: Engineering where *hardware* meets *software*.
paragraphs: I’m an Electronic and Computer Engineering graduate from the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, with a strong passion for building reliable software and intelligent hardware systems.

My work spans backend engineering, embedded systems, electronics and full-stack development. I enjoy solving complex technical problems, designing scalable systems, and turning ideas into functional products that create real-world impact.

focus.text: Firmware, microcontrollers, sensors and connected devices that work reliably in the field.
